_meta.indication: DAURISMO is indicated, in combination with low-dose cytarabine, for the treatment of newly-diagnosed acute myeloid leukemia (AML) in adult patients who are >=75 years old or who have comorbidities that preclude use of intensive induction chemotherapy.

pivotal_trials.design: Multicenter, open-label, randomized study; patients randomized 2:1 to glasdegib 100 mg daily with low-dose cytarabine or low-dose cytarabine alone, stratified by cytogenetic risk.
pivotal_trials.population: 115 patients age 55 years or older with newly-diagnosed AML meeting at least one of: age >=75 years, severe cardiac disease, baseline ECOG performance status of 2, or baseline serum creatinine >1.3 mg/dL.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Overall survival (OS) from the date of randomization to death from any cause.
pivotal_trials.n: N=115 (77 glasdegib + low-dose cytarabine; 38 low-dose cytarabine alone)
pivotal_trials.result: Median OS 8.3 months (95% CI 4.4, 12.2) with glasdegib + LDAC vs 4.3 months (95% CI 1.9, 5.7) with LDAC alone; HR 0.46 (95% CI 0.30, 0.71); p=0.0002. CR rate 18.2% vs 2.6%.

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (incidence >=20%) are anemia, fatigue, hemorrhage, febrile neutropenia, musculoskeletal pain, nausea, edema, thrombocytopenia, dyspnea, decreased appetite, dysgeusia, mucositis, constipation, and rash. Serious adverse reactions occurred in 79% of patients; most common serious ARs were febrile neutropenia (29%), pneumonia (23%), hemorrhage (12%), anemia (7%), and sepsis (7%).
target_moa: Glasdegib is a hedgehog pathway inhibitor (Smoothened/SMO inhibitor).

boxed_warning.content: WARNING: EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY – DAURISMO can cause embryo-fetal death or severe birth defects when administered to a pregnant woman; it is embryotoxic, fetotoxic, and teratogenic in animals. Conduct pregnancy testing prior to initiation and advise effective contraception.

summary.text: Glasdegib received regular (full) approval based on an overall survival benefit in the Phase 2 portion of Study B1371003 (BRIGHT AML 1003). The NDA was received 4/27/2018 and reviewed under Priority Review; the drug had Orphan Designation for treatment of AML granted 6/28/2017. The application was not discussed by an Advisory Committee.

citations.quote: Nonetheless, with adequate labeling and a Medication Guide in place, the overall survival benefit outweighs the risks as described and supports regular approval for the indication
